translations.web: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.
translations.bsb: What fruit did you reap at that time from the things of which you are now ashamed? The outcome of those things is death.
translations.kjv: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
